name: Gorgrond
about: Gorgrond (class 1055), the strong, slow Acolyte of the Enclave on Daemon's Crag, Vardion's devoted follower; hostile once Bane has won (G[142:2] = 2). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: What does it feel like when the Master draws on your power?
say: Huh? Nobody asks me that. Vardion says not to think about it.
It's cold. Like the fire goes out in my belly. Then I'm sleepy, very sleepy, and my hands won't do spells.
It comes back. Slowly. A few days. Then I'm strong again, and he needs it again.
That's good, isn't it? Being needed? ...Why are you looking at me like that, Dungbreath?
